summary: Media card with a generated dithered landscape whose ridges shift at different depths as the card tilts toward the pointer.

attributes.name: hue
attributes.description: Base hue in degrees for the sky and ridges. Observed.

attributes.name: seed
attributes.description: Seed for the ridge shapes. Observed.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated tag chips; an empty value shows none. Observed.

attributes.name: alt
attributes.description: Accessible name of the landscape canvas. Observed.

accessibility: The landscape canvas has `role="img"` with `aria-label` from `alt`.
Title and description are slotted text.
The card has no link, button or focus target of its own.
motion: With reduced motion the card does not tilt and the landscape does not drift; the canvas redraws only on pointer movement.

slots.name: title
slots.description: Card title. Falls back to `Pixel Valley`.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Description. Falls back to a sample sentence.

notes: Without reduced motion the canvas redraws every frame while the card is visible.
Stars twinkle in the sky only in the dark theme.
